UNSTARRED QUESTION No. 2350 
TO BE ANSWERED ON 5TH AUGUST, 2022 
                                                                Depleting fish stocks 
2350. SHRI LUIZINHO JOAQUIM FALEIRO: 
         Wil
l the Minister of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying be pleased to state: 
 
(a) whether Government is aware that the traditional fishermen in Goa are facing difficult times 
due to depleting fish stocks; 
(b) whether massive illegal trawling with LED lights are taking away the fish even during the 
spawning period when they lay eggs; and  
(c) whether the coastal police does not have even a single boat in working condition to chase 
the trawlers and implement the ban on illegal fishing? 
 ANSWER 
 
 THE MINISTER OF FISHERIES, ANIMAL HUSBANDRY AND DAIRYING 
 
  (SHRI PARSHOTTAM RUPALA) 
 
(a):  The marine fish production from Goa State for the last five years 2016-17 to 2020-21 ranged 
between 1.01-1.18 lakh tonnes and as such there is no substantial decrease in fish catch. Besides, 
there is no report received regarding depletion in fish stock in coast of Goa State.     
(b) & (c):   The destructive fishing practices such as paired or Bull trawling and use of artificial  
lights/ LED lights for fishing are banned in the Exclusive Economic Zone of India (EEZ) beyond 
the territorial waters vide Order dated 10.11.2017. The Union Government has also advised the 
Coastal States and Union Territories from time to time to issue necessary Orders to prohibit 
destructive fishing methods including use of LED lights for fishing. The Government of Goa vide 
its Order dated 10.05.2016 has also prohibited the use or installation of LED lights on mechanized 
fishing vessel or motorized fishing crafts. The Department of Fisheries, Government of Goa has 
reported that it has strictly enforced the monsoon fishing ban period and that it regularly conducts 
patrolling within the territorial waters of the State. Besides, the State Government has sanctioned 
02 fast interceptor patrol boats for coastal security.

(a) to (c):    The Department of Fisheries, Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying 
during the financial year 2018-19 created Fisheries and Aquaculture Infrastructure Development 
Fund (FIDF) with a total fund size of Rs 7522.48 crore. FIDF provides concessional finance to 
the Eligible Entities (EEs), including State Governments/Union Territories and State entities for 
development of identified fisheries infrastructure facilities. The concessional finance is provided 
through Nodal Loaning Entities (NLEs) namely (i) National Bank for Agriculture and Rural 
Development (NABARD), (ii) National Cooperatives Development Corporation (NCDC) and (iii) 
All scheduled Banks. Under the FIDF, the Department of Fisheries, Government of India provides 
interest subvention up to 3% per annum for providing the concessional finance by the NLEs at the 
interest rate not lower than 5% per annum.  The objectives of FIDF are; (i) Creation and 
modernization of capture & culture fisheries infrastructure, (ii) Creation of Marine Aquaculture 
Infrastructure, (iii) Creation and modernization of Inland Fisheries Infrastructure, (iv) Reduce 
post-harvest losses and improve domestic marketing facilities through infrastructure support, (v) 
To bridge the resource gap and facilitate completion of ongoing infrastructure projects.   
 
Based on the proposals submitted by the State Governments, Government agencies, 
cooperatives, FFPOs and entrepreneurs/private entities,  the  Department of Fisheries, Ministry of 
Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying has so far accorded approval to the project proposals 
at a total cost of Rs. 3921.91 crore under FIDF
 and State-wise details of these approved projects 
is furnished at Annexure- I. So far no proposal has been submitted either by the Government of 
Bihar or by the entrepreneurs/farmers in Bihar for sanction under FIDF. Since the  scheme is a 
demand driven, no State-wise physical targets have been set under the FIDF.

2353. SHRI SHAKTISINH GOHIL: 
 
    Will the Minister of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying be pleased to state: 
 
(a)  whether it is a fact that Pakistani marine officials capture Indian fishermen and their boats, 
due to which families of fisherman are rendered destitute and unemployed; 
(b)  whether Government has ever provided compensation or subsidy or financial assistance 
for buying new boats or to repay bank loans or for providing any kind of relief; 
(c)  if so, the year-wise number of fishermen in Gujarat and the quantum of financial assistance 
provided to them; and  
(d)  whether Government would provide financial assistance to such fishermen to purchase new 
boats? 
ANSWER 
 THE MINISTER OF FISHERIES, ANIMAL HUSBANDRY AND DAIRYING 
  (SHRI PARSHOTTAM RUPALA) 
(a) to (d): The Government of India attaches the highest priority to the welfare, safety and security 
of Indian fishermen. As soon as cases of apprehension of Indian fishermen and their fishing boats 
by Pakistan are reported, immediate steps are taken by the Indian Mission in Islamabad towards 
seeking consular access from the Pakistan Government. All possible assistance, including legal 
assistance, is extended to the fishermen for their early release and repatriation, along with the 
release of their boats. Cases of apprehension of Indian fishermen and their fishing boats by 
Pakistan authorities are taken up with the Pakistan Government immediately after the occurrence 
and on a regular basis thereafter for early release. 
The Department of Fisheries has implemented a scheme of Soft Loan Package for Replacement of 
Fishing Vessels held in captivity in Pakistan through Marine Products Export Development 
Authority (MPEDA) from 2009-2019 Under the scheme, the Department of Fisheries has released 
a sum of 11
.52croreto MPEDA from 2009 to 2019 for replacement of 192 fishing vessels held in 
capacity in Pakistan. Further the Department of Fisheries is implementing PMMSY from 2020-21 
in which there is provision of assistance for procurement of Deep sea fishing vessels. In 2020-21 
and 2021-22 the Department of Fisheries has accorded approval to the fisheries development  
 
 
364

 
proposals of Government of Gujarat under the Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana 
(PMMSY) at a total cost of Rs437.25 crore which includes approval for 100 units of deep sea 
fishing vessels for traditional fishermen. Under this scheme, the fishermen whose boats are in 
custody of Pakistan can be assisted to procure new boats subject to them being otherwise eligible 
under PMMSY. 
The Government of Gujarat is also providing an amount of Rs 300/- per day to the family member 
of State Fishermen as financial assistance who has been captured by Pakistan Marine Security 
Agency up to the period of Fishermen remain in Pakistan custody.The details of fishermen and the

FOOD PROCESSING SECTOR'S CONTRIBUTION IN GDP 
 
 
2356. SMT. SEEMA DWIVEDI: 
 
Will the Minister of FOOD PROCESSING INDUSTRIES be pleased to state: 
 
(a) the extent of contribution of the food processing sector in India's GDP; 
 
(b) whether Government is taking any meaningful steps to generate employment and promote 
entrepreneurship in this sector, if so, the details thereof; 
 
(c) the details of the activities undertaken by Government to attract FDI into this sector; and 
 
(d) the State-wise number of multinational food processing units in India? 
 
 
ANSWER 
 
 
THE MINISTER OF STATE FOR FOOD PROCESSING INDUSTRIES 
(SHRI PRAHALAD SINGH PATEL) 
 
(a): The contribution of the food processing sector has increased continuously with Gross 
Value Added (GVA) in food processing sector from Rs.1.34 lakh crore in 2014-15 to Rs. 2.37 lakh 
crore in 2020-21 at a Compound Annual Growth Rate (CAGR) of 9.97%. 
 
(b): The Ministry of Food Processing Industries (MoFPI) implements various schemes with an 
objective of overall growth and developmen t of the food processing sector, creation of off -farm 
employment and entrepreneurial opportunities whose details are as under: 
 
(i). MoFPI implements the Pradhan Mantri Kisan SAMPADA Yojana (PMKSY) which, inter –
alia, aims at creation of modern post-harvest infrastructure, value addition, providing better returns 
to farmers, creation of off-farm employment opportunities etc.

Processing Enterprises (PMFME) Scheme for providing financial, technical and business support 
for setting up/upgradation of two lakh existing micro food processing enterpris es across the 
country on One District One Product (ODOP) approach.  
(iii). A new Production Linked Incentive scheme (PLIS) for Food Processing Sector is being 
implemented to support creation of global food manufacturing champions. The scheme 
incentivizes investment and will promote exports and employment in the sector. 
 
(c): To attract Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) in the food processing sector, the Government 
has put in pl ace an investor -friendly policy  wherein 100% FDI is allowed for food product s’ 
manufacturing under the automatic route, and 100% FDI under Government approval route is 
allowed for retail trading, including through e -commerce, in respect of food products 
manufactured and/or produced in India. Also, to facilitate all investment interests, MoFPI has set 
369

up a dedicated Nivesh Bandhu portal as well as an Investment Facilitation Cell with Invest India. 
The total FDI inflow in the food processing sector during last 5 years ending 2021-22 is USD 3.54 
billion. 
 
(d): As per the latest Annual Survey of Industries (ASI) 2018 -19, released by Ministry of 
Statistics and Programme Implementation, 40579 food processing units are in the registered sector.

The details of assistance available under PMFME Scheme 
 
(i). Support to Individual / Group Category Micro Enterprises:  Credit-linked capital subsidy 
@35% of the eligible project cost, maximum ceiling Rs.10 lakh per unit; 
 
(ii). Support to SHGs for seed capital:  Seed capital @ Rs. 40,000/ - per member of SHG 
engaged in food processing for working capital and purchase of small tools subject to 
maximum of Rs. 4 lakh per SHG Federation. 
  
(iii). Support for Common In frastructure: Credit linked capital subsidy @35% subject to 
maximum of Rs. 3 crore to support FPOs, SHGs, Cooperatives and any Government agency 
for setting up of common infrastructure. The common infrastructure will also be available for 
other units and public to utilize on hiring basis for substantial part of the capacity.  
 
(iv). Branding and Marketing Support: Grant upto 50% for Branding and Marketing to groups 
of FPOs/ SHGs/ Cooperatives or an SPV of micro food processing enterprises.  
 
(v). Capacity Building: The scheme envisages training for Entrepreneurship Development 
Skilling (EDP+): program modified to meet the requirement of food processing industry and 
product specific skilling.

GOVERNMENTOF INDIA

UNSTARRED QUESTION NO- 2360 
ANSWERED ON- 05.08.2022 
 
REFORMS IN THE FOOD PROCESSING SECTOR 
 
 
2360. SHRI PRABHAKAR REDDY VEMIREDDY: 
 
Will the Minister of FOOD PROCESSING INDUSTRIES be pleased to state: 
 
 
(a) the reforms that Government has brought/proposed to bring in the food processing sector 
of the country; 
 
(b) how allowing 100 per cent FDI through automatic route helps in attracting more FDI; 
 
(c) the details of FDI flow into food processing sector since introduction of FDI through the 
automatic route, year-wise; and 
 
(d) the status of Food Processing Fund set up with NABARD and whether objectives of this 
fund have been achieved? 
 
 
ANSWER 
 
THE MINISTER OF STATE FOR FOOD PROCESSING INDUSTRIES 
(SHRI PRAHLAD SINGH PATEL) 
 
(a): The Government has taken various policy measures and reforms to support food processing 
sector as indicated below: 
 
(i) Inclusion of food & agro -based processing units and cold chain as agricultural 
activity under Priority Sector Lending (PSL) norms in April 2015.  
(ii) As a measure towards of ease of doing business, the Food Safety and Standards 
Authority of India (FSSAI) through notifications in 2016 has shifted from product-
by-product approval to an ingredient and additive based approval process. 
(iii) A Special Food Processing Fund of Rs. 2000 crore was set up with National Bank 
for Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD) to provide affordable credit for 
investments in setting up Mega Food Parks (MFP) as well as processing units in the 
MFPs. In 2019, the coverage of the fund was extended to setting up of Agro 
Processing Clusters and individual manufacturing units within them.  
(iv) 100 percent F oreign Direct Investment (F DI) approval under automatic route has 
been permitted for the food processing sector. 
 
376

(b) & (c): The Government has put in place a liberal and transparent policy for attracting Foreign 
Direct Investment (FDI), wherein most of the sectors are open to FDI unde r the automatic route. 
The intent is to make the FDI policy more investor friendly and remove the policy bottlenecks that 
have been hindering the investment inflows into the country. 100% FDI is permitted under the 
automatic route in the food processing sector and 100% FDI under Government approval route is 
allowed for retail trading, including through e -commerce, in respect of food products 
manufactured and/or produced in India. Allowing 100% FDI through automatic route helps to 
attract more FDI as under the automatic route, the investment does not require the prior approval. 
The details of year-wise FDI inflow from April 2016 to March 2022 is as under;  
 
Statement on financial year wise FDI equity inflow (From APRIL 2016 to March 2022) 
                          
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
                  Source- FDI Cell DPIIT 
 
(d): A special fund of Rs.2000 crore has been set up in National Bank for Agriculture and Rural 
Development (NABARD) to provide credit at affordable rates to boost food processing sector. 
Under this fund, loan is extended to individual entrepreneurs, cooperatives, farmer s producer 
organizations, corporates, joint ventures, SP Vs and entities promoted by the Government for 
setting up, modernization, expansion of food processing units and development of infrastructure 
in designated food parks. The Ministry has notified the Designated Food Parks (DFPs) in different 
states for the purpose of availing affordable credit from special fund with NABARD. NABARD 
has sanctioned a term loan of Rs 776.82 Crore as on 30.06.2022. The details of term loan

(e): MoFPI is implementing the Research and Development scheme with objective that the 
end product/findings should benefit food processing industry in terms of product and process 
development, efficient technologies, improved packaging,  etc. along with standardization of 
various factors viz. additives, colouring agents, preservatives, pesticide residues, etc. In order 
to improve the research and development in this sector, the scheme guidelines are amended 
from time to time. Some of the provisions in the present scheme guidelines for better outcome 
of research and development are: 
  
• Preference is given to those proposals which are beneficial for small & medium 
enterprises and farmers and are intended toward commercialization of the said 
technology.  
 
• The R&D projects would be carried out in collaboration with the industrial partner, 
which can take up/ purchase/ commercialize outcome technology developed through the 
project. 
  
• Project Investigators are encouraged to seek legal/patent protec tion for the outcome of 
research/ technology developed.

GOVERNMENTOF INDIA 
MINISTRY OF FOOD PROCESSING INDUSTRIES 
RAJYA SABHA 
UNSTARRED QUESTION NO- 2364 
ANSWERED ON- 05.08.2022 
 
STEPS TAKEN TO BOOST EXPORTS OF PROCESSED FOOD 
 
2364. SHRI SANJEEV ARORA: 
 
Will the Minister of Food Processing Industries be pleased to state: 
 
(a) the steps being taken by Government to boost exports of processed food; and 
 
(b) whether Government plans to give any incentives for export of processed food? 
 
 
ANSWER 
 
THE MINISTER OF STATE FOR FOOD PROCESSING INDUSTRIES 
(SHRI PRAHLAD SINGH PATEL) 
 
(a) & (b): The various efforts being made by Government for promoting exports of processed 
food products are: 
(i) A comprehensive “Agriculture Export Policy” has been introduced to harness export 
potential of Indian agriculture. 
(ii) Products Specific Export Promotion Forums set up by Agricultural and Processed Food 
Products Export Development Authority (APEDA) to give impetus to the export of potential 
products as well as to remove the bottlenecks in the supply chain.  
(iii) APEDA has also formed Export Promotion Forums (EPFs) for the products, viz., Grapes, 
Onions, Mango, Banana, Pomegranate, Floriculture, Rice, Dairy Products and Nutri cereals. 
(iv) A Farmer Connect Portal has been set up for providing a platform for farmers, Fa rmer 
Producer Organizations (FPOs) and cooperatives to interact with exporters. 
(v) Assistance provided through several other schemes to promote exports, including food  
products export, viz. Trade Infrastructure for Export Scheme (TIES), Market Access Initiatives 
(MAI) Scheme, Remission of Duties and Taxes on Exported Products (RoDTEP), Export 
Promotion schemes of Agricultural and Processed Food Products Export Development 
Authority (APEDA) & Marine Products Export Development Authority (MPEDA), etc. 
(vi) District as Export Hubs (DEH) scheme is being implemented using ODOP  (One District 
One Product) approach with an objective of converting each District of the country into a 
Manufacturing and Export Hub by identifying products with export potential in the district. 
(vii) Under the Production Linked Incentives (PLI) scheme for food products, marketing and 
branding support is provided by Ministry of Food Processing Industries for enha ncing global 
visibility of Indian food products.

AVAILABILITY OF COLD CHAIN FOR FRUITS AND VEGETABLES 
  
 
2365. SHRI NARESH BANSAL: 
  
Will the Minister of FOOD PROCESSING INDUSTRIES be pleased to state: 
  
 
(a) whether sufficient cold chain storages are in place to check wastage of fruits and  
vegetables in the country’ 
   
(b) the number of cold chain facilities in country, State-wise, district-wise, specially in 
Uttarakhand; and 
  
(c) the steps taken by the Central Government, in consultation with Government of  
Uttarakhand, to further strengthen cold chain management in the State along with the details 
thereof? 
  
ANSWER 
  
THE MINISTER OF STATE FOR FOOD PROCESSING INDUSTRIES 
(SHRI PRAHLAD SINGH PATEL) 
  
(a): The NABARD Consultancy Services Pvt. Ltd. (NABCONS) had conducted a study on 
“All India Cold Chain Infrastructure Capacity (Assessment of Status & Gap)” that was 
commissioned by National Centre for Cold Chain Development (NCCD) under Department of 
Agriculture, Cooperation and Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare. 
The study was primarily based on requirement of fruits & vegetables.  As per the study, the 
requirement of cold storages in the country is 35 milli on MT, while capacity of projects 
approved by the Government is around 32 million MT.  
  
(b) & (c): The Ministry of Food Processing Industries (MoFPI) is implementing the "Integrated 
Cold Chain and Value Addition Infrastructure Scheme" for extending financial support by way 
of grants-in-aid to those successful individuals/ entities who are interested in establishing such 
facilities.  Expression of Interest (EoI) is floated from time to time inviting proposals. The last 
EoI has been floated on 21.06.2022. 
  
       The details of 357 such projects approved so far by MoFPI, including those in Uttarakhand, 
are given in Annexure.

STATUS OF ELECTRIC VEHICLES IN DIFFERENT CATEGORIES 
 
2368. SHRI PRAKASH JAVADEKAR:  
 
Will the Minister of Heavy Industries be pleased to state: 
 
(a) the latest scenario of electrical vehicles in category 2, 3 and 4 wheelers in use, the details 
thereof; and 
 
(b) the status of electrical charging infrastructure? 
 
ANSWER 
THE MINISTER OF STATE FOR HEAVY INDUSTRIES 
(SHRI KRISHAN PAL GURJAR) 
 
(a):  Sir, a total of 13,92,265 Electric Vehicles (EVs) are being used on the roads of India as on 3rd 
August, 2022 as per the information received from Ministry of Road Transport and Highways.  The 
details are as under: 
 
Sl. No. Vehicle Category  No. of electric vehicles  
1 Two Wheeler             5,44,643 
2. Three Wheeler           7,93,370 
3. Four wheeler and above  54,252 
Grand Total 13,92,265 
 
Further, sale of EVs in FY 2021-22 has gone up over three times as compared to sale of EVs 
in FY 2020 -21 from to 1,34,460 (e2W:41048, e3W -88391 and e4w -5021) to 4,28,224.00 (e2W: 
2,31,434, e3W: 1 ,77,884, e4W:18,906) as per the information available on VAHAN -4 centralized 
database of RC (Registration Certificate).  The increase in sale of EVs is attributed mainly to the 
incentive provided under FAME India Scheme Phase -II, provided to buyers of electric  vehicles 
meeting FAME criteria in the form of an upfront reduction in the purchase price of electric vehicles. 
The incentive is linked to battery capacity i.e. Rs. 10,000/KWh for e -3W and e-4W with a cap 20% 
of the cost of vehicle.  Further, the incentive / subsidies for e -2W has been increased to Rs. 
15,000/KWh from Rs. 10,000/KWh with an increase in cap from 20% to 40% of the cost of vehicle 
w.e.f. 11th  June, 2021. 
Further, following steps have been taken by the Government for adoption of electric vehicles 
in the country: 
i. The Government on 12 th  May, 2021 approved the Production Linked Incentive (PLI) scheme for 
manufacturing of Advanced Chemistry Cell (ACC) in the country in order to bring down prices of 
battery in the country.  Drop in battery prices will result in cost reduction of electric vehicles.  
ii. Electric Vehicles are eligible for incentive under PLI scheme for Automobile and auto 
Components, which was approved on 15 th September, 2021 with a budgetary outlay of Rs. 25,938 
crore for a period of five years. 
 
402

-2- 
 
iii. GST on electric vehicles has been reduced from 12% to 5%; GST on chargers/ charging stations 
for electric vehicles has been reduced from 18% to 5%. 
iv. Ministry of Road Transport & Highways (MoRTH) announced that battery-operated vehicles will 
be given green license plates and be exempted from permit requirements. 
v. MoRTH issued a notification advising states to waive  road tax on EVs, which in turn will help 
reduce the initial cost of EVs. 
 
(b):  Under Phase-II of FAME-India Scheme, Rs. 1000 Cr has been allocated for the development 
of charging infrastructure.  The Ministry of Heavy Industries had sanctioned 520 Charging Stations/ 
Infrastructure under the Phase-I of FAME India Scheme.  Further, this Ministry has also sanctioned 
2,877 Electric Vehicle Charging Stations in 68 cities across 25 States/UTs and 1576 charging stations 
across 9 Expressways and 16 Highways under Phase II of FAME India Scheme.  Under FAME India 
Scheme I & II, a total of 532 c harging stations have been installed as on 15 th July, 2022 (479 under 
FAME-I and 53 under FAME -II).  Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas (MoPNG) has informed 
that Oil Marketing Companies (OMCs) as on 01.07.2022 established 3448 electric vehicle charging 
stations at their Retail Outlets (ROs).   The details are given at ANNEXURE.

the purpose of preventing human trafficking;  
(b)  whether these centres are being run with the help of NGOs; 
(c)  the number of children freed from trafficking so far under Operation Nanhe Farishte; and 
(d) the similar other measures being taken by the Railways? 
 
 
 
ANSWER 
MINISTER OF RAILWAYS, COMMUNICATIONS AND  
ELECTRONICS & INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY  
     
(SHRI ASHWINI VAISHNAW) 
 
(a) to (d):  A Statement is laid on the Table of the House.  
***** 
 
 
 
 
408

 
 
STATEMENT REFERRED TO IN REPLY TO PARTS (a) TO (d) OF UNSTARRED QUESTION 
NO. 2371 BY MS. INDU BALA GOSWAMI ANSWERED IN RAJYA SABHA ON 05.08.2022 
REGARDING PREVENTION OF HUMAN TRAFFICKING IN RAILWAYS 
 
(a) to (d):  ‘Police’ and ‘Public Order’ are State subjects under the Seventh Schedule to the 
Constitution of India and, as such, State Governments are responsible for prevention, detection, 
registration and investigation of crime and maintaining law and order etc. on Railways through their 
law enforcement agencies viz. Government Railway Police (GRP)/local Police. Railway Protection 
Force (RPF) supplements the efforts of GRP/local Police to provide better protection and security of 
passenger area and passengers and for matters connected therewith. RPF is not empowered to 
investigate cases of Human Trafficking and whenever any case of suspected human trafficking is 
detected by RPF, the same is reported to GRP/District Police. The persons rescued and apprehended 
are handed over to concerned Police for further necessary action as per law.  
 
Children in need of care and protection coming in contact with Railways, who can be prospective 
victim of Human Trafficking are rescued regularly, in accordance with the provisions of the  Standard 
Operating Procedure (SOP) issued by Railways in coordination with Ministry of Women & Child 
Development and NCPCR (National Commission for Protection of Child Rights) under the Operation 
‘Nanhe Farishte’ launched by RPF for rescue of such children.   
 
In order to strengthen action against Human Trafficking, more than 750 Anti Human Trafficking Units 
(AHTUs) have been setup by RPF over the Indian Railways.  These AHTUs coordinate with AHTUs 
of Police & CAPFs (Central Armed Police Forces) i.e. BSF & SSB functioning at district level/state 
levels/International Borders and with Intelligence Units, NGOs and other stakeholders and take 
effective action on traffickers as per law. 
 
RPF has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with Association of Voluntary Action 
(AVA) also known as Bachpan Bachao Andolan (an NGO), who is assisting in training and capacity 
building of RPF, GRP and other railway staff on all child protection issues and in implementation of 
sensitization and awareness campaigns. Also, AVA shares intelligence information pertaining to 
suspected traffickers and their activities with RPF to conduct raids and help in rescue of trafficked 
children. 
 
Further, a pan India Drive ‘Operation AAHT’ is undertaken by RPF focused to take effective action in 
cases of Human Trafficking through railways. During the current year (upto June), total 150 children 
being trafficked through railway system have been rescued by RPF from the clutches of traffickers 
under ‘Operation AAHT’.  
--2/- 
 
409

 
-2- 
Further, the following steps are being taken by the Railways in coordination with GRP/District Police 
to prevent Human Trafficking through trains and railway premises:- 
 
1. Train escorting parties and staff deployed in mass contact areas have been sensitized and trained 
to identify the potential victims of trafficking and immediate action taken to rescue them. 
2. An Exhaustive Security circular No.03/2022 dated 02.02.2022, detailing action plan to be taken 
by RPF against Human Trafficking have been issued.   
3.
 To supplement the efforts of State Police, Cyber cells of RPF have been instructed for cyber 
patrolling of the web/social media to look for digital footprints/traces of human trafficking in the 
internet and to cull out the clues helpful in taking action against Human Trafficking through 
railways. 
4. The subject of “Human Trafficking” have been included in all training courses conducted in RPF 
Training Centres.  Also, time to time Special seminars are organised to sensitize RPF personnel 
and train them in identification of victims and traffickers.   
5.
 Periodic review meetings are held with Nodal Officers of Anti Human 
Trafficking Units and other concerned agencies from time to time to 
review the efforts undertaken to combat human trafficking. 
6.
 Surveillance is kept through CCTV cameras provided in 5882 coaches and 861 Railway Stations 
for enhanced security of passengers.

411

 
STATEMENT REFERRED TO IN REPLY TO PARTS (a) To (d) OF UNSTARRED QUESTION 
NO. 2372 BY SANT BALBIR SINGH ANSWERED IN RAJYA SABHA ON 05.08.2022 
REGARDING DESILTING OF RIVER BEDS UNDER RAILWAY BRIDGES IN PUNJAB. 
 
(a) to (d): Safety of bridges across the country including the Railway Bridges in Punjab is accorded 
high priority by Indian Railways. Railways follow a well established system of inspection and  
monitoring of each bridge twice a year, once before the onset of monsoon and once after monsoon 
by the designated officials.  
 
 To ensure clearing away of obstructions in waterways on both sides of the line within 
Railway limits at bridges, for the full extent of the waterway prior to monsoon, requisite appropriate 
action is being taken as per the existing guidelines/frequency as stipulated in Indian Railways 
Bridge Manual-1998. Accordingly, under Railway Bridges,  cleaning/desilting of waterways is 
being carried out every year on condition basis before the onset of monsoon.  Desilting of river beds 
within Railway limits at bridges is a continuous process to ensure clearing away any obstructions in 
flow of waterway. 
 
 Since Railway Bridges are designed with the adequate vertical clearance and free board, thus, 
generally no low lying Railway Bridge on river beds across the country and where the incidence of 
flooding has 
occurred due to silting of river bed.  
 
 However, there is only one Bridge No. 97 (19x24.4m) Plate Girder (Meter Gauge) at km 
241/0-5, in North Eastern Railway, on Sharda River between Paliakalan & Bhirakheri stations in 
Gonda-Mailani Section which is affected due to silting in Sharda River.

416

STATEMENT REFERRED TO IN REPLY TO PARTS (a) TO (d) OF UNSTARRED 
QUESTION NO. 2374 BY DR. PRASHANTA NANDA ANSWERED IN RAJYA SABHA ON 
05.08.2022 REGARDING KHURDHA ROAD-BALANGIR NEW RAILWAY LINE 
PROJECT.                                  
(a): Yes, Sir.  The roof slab of the under construction Road Under Bridge partially collapsed due 
to sabotage action of disturbing the vertical props and  bracing arrangements provided to support 
of the slab concrete.  Casting of slab completed at around 9:30 PM and this incident happened at 
around 10:30-11:00  PM on 04.03.2022.  To save the structure beneath, Project Management 
Consultant (PMC) in charge of the work took steps immediately to remove the freshly poured 
slab concrete before its initial setting.   It was reported by PMC that some of miscreants have 
disturbed the staging work due to which the casted slab got collapsed partially.   In this 
connection, an FIR had also been lodged by the agency with the local police station at 
Manmunda, Boudh.  
(b): 
Due to immediate removal of green concrete just before setting time, no damage caused to 
the existing structure.   
(c): All the concrete are produced by Automatic Batching plants and quality of concrete is 
ensured. Testing of Concrete cubes cast from each batch of concrete is being done.   
Reinforcement/Staging works are also checked as per the drawings designed/approved and then 
only casting of concrete is allowed. Relevant records as per the railway approved Quality 
Assurance Manual for all the works done are maintained and also checked from time to time. 
(d): It has been directed to the agency to deploy watchman with lighting arrangement at the 
location of casting for a period of 07 days (minimum) to avoid any type of sabotage.

MISSION RAFTAAR 
      
2376. DR. SANTANU SEN: 
 
   
Will the Minister of RAILWAYS  be pleased to state: 
(a) the allocation and utilization of funds under Mission Raftaar since 2017, year-wise; 
(b) whether mission Raftaar completely failed in achieving its target according to a CAG report 
tabled in budget session 2022, if so, the reasons therefor; 
(c) the details of the deadline Government is proposing, to increase the speed of passenger train to 
75 km per hour and freight train to 5 km per hour; 
(d) whether Government has conducted any study on the effectiveness of this scheme, if so, the 
details thereof; 
and 
(e) if not, the reasons therefor? 
 
ANSWER 
 
MINISTER OF RAILWAYS, COMMUNICATIONS AND  
ELECTRONICS & INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY 
 
(SHRI ASHWINI VAISHNAW) 
 
 (a) Mission Raftaar is a ‘Mission’ envisaged for speed enhancement and to achieve a target of 
doubling average speed of freight trains and increasing the average speed of Superfast /mail/Express 
trains by 25 kmph and not a stand alone ‘Project(s)’. The overall allocation and utilization of funds 
under Mission Raftaar can not be quantified. 
(b) & (c) CAG report tabled in budget session 2022 has analyzed the punctuality and travel time in 
train operations in Indian Railways as a whole. Mission Raftaar is only one of the document used as 
Audit criteria for preparation of report.  Speeding up of trains is a constant endeavour and a 
continuous process on Indian Railways which is dependent on constant optimization of the 
investments made by Railways in modernization of technology, high powered locos, modern 
coaches and better tracks. To this end Indian Railways are inter alia proliferating Hofmann Busch 
(LHB) coaches which have higher speed potential, converting passenger trains operating with 
conventional coaches into MEMU services (which have higher acceleration/deceleration owing to 
419

distrusted power). As a part of “Mission Raftaar” and during the period 2015 -16 and 2021-22, 414 
passenger train services have been converted into MEMU services. 
Indian Railway is constructing more than 3000 Km of Dedicated Freight Corridor(DFC), which 
would enable freight trains to run at speed of 100 kmph. 
There is marked improvement in average freight train speed. 
During financial year 2016-17 to financial year 2020-21, Average speed of freight train has 
increased from 23.7 kms/hr to 41.2 kms/hr. 
(d) No, Sir. 
(e) Mission Raftaar is a ‘Mission’ and not a ‘scheme/project(s)’, and improvement in average speed 
of trains is a continuous exercise on Indian Railways,  hence need for such study does not arise.

(a) to (c): ‘Police’ and ‘Public Order’ are State subjects under the Seventh Schedule to the Constitution 
of India and, therefore, State Governments are responsible for prevention, detection, registration and 
investigation of crime and maintenance of law and order on Railways through their law enforcement 
agencies viz. Government Railway Police (GRP)/District Police. Railway Protection Force (RPF) 
supplements the efforts of GRP/District Police to provide better protection and security to railway 
property, passenger area and passengers and for matters connected therewith. Cases of damage, 
destruction of government property including railway property are registered and investigated by the 
concerned GRP/State Police under IPC & Railways Act.  
 
In the year 2022, Indian Railways suffered loss of ₹259.44 crores due to damage/destruction of railway 
assets in agitations against Agnipath Scheme. Separate data regarding amount of refund granted to 
passengers due to disruption of rail services on account of public disorder consequent to agitation like 
those held after launching of Agnipath Scheme is not maintained.  However, during the period 
14.06.2022 to 30.06.2022, a total refund of approximately ₹102.96 crores was granted on account of 
cancellation of trains.

(a)  to (d): Angamali-Sabarimala new rail line was sanctioned in 1997-98 at a cost of ₹ 550 crore. 
Total length of the project is 116 Km.  
  
 5 km section of this project was passing through Periyar Tiger Reserve Forest. On the 
request of State Government, the project was terminated at Erumeli due to reserve forest area. 
Alignment of the project passes through three Districts i.e. Ernakulam, Idukki and Kottayam 
districts. Final location survey (FLS) for Angamali-Kaladi-Ramapuram section (70 Km) was 
completed in 2002 and further survey in the Kottayam district was stopped by local people in 
2007 due to objections on alignment. The final project report can be prepared only after Final 
Location Survey is completed. 
 
 Consequently, in this project, work on Angamali-Kaladi (7 Km) and long lead works on 
Kaladi-Perumbavoor (10 Km) have been taken up. However, further works on this project could 
not be taken forward due to protests by local people against land acquisition and fixing of 
alignment of the line, court cases filed against the project and inadequate response from the State 
Government of Kerala.  
 
 Government of Kerala vide their letter dated 27.11.2015 agreed to share 50% cost of the 
project. Government of Kerala had also identified this project for execution under Joint Venture 
Scheme with Ministry of Railways and therefore, an MoU was also signed on 01.09.2016.  
Unfortunately, within a year, the State Government vide letter dated 15.11.2016 withdrew their 
own consent to share 50% cost of the project.  Government of Kerala has not deposited any share 
of cost for the project. Project is held up on this account.  
 
 After long persuasion, recently Government of Kerala vide letter dated 07.01.2021 has 
conveyed their decision to share 50% of the total project cost of Angamali - Sabarimala Railway 
project through Kerala Infrastructure Investment Fund Board (KIIFB), subject to the condition 
that operation and maintenance of  the  track shall  be done  by  Ministry of  Railways  while  the  
 
 ...2/- 
 
426

-2- 
 
stations along the route  will be developed by a Special Purpose Vehicle (SPV) (through public 
private partnership route) and the net revenue realized by the SPV will be shared on a 50:50 
basis between State Government and Ministry of Railways, after offsetting the cost of Operation 
& Maintenance (O&M) as agreed to by Railways. M/S KRDCL was advised to complete Final 
Location Survey and to update the project cost.     
 
 Accordingly, M/S KRDCL completed the Final Location Survey (FLS) and submitted the 
Detailed Project Report (DPR) and Detailed Estimate (DE) of the full project to Southern 
Railways on 23.06.2022. Approval depends upon various factors like accuracy in assessment of 
quantity, specification considered as per existing policy guidelines, genuineness in rate of items 
taken to assess the cost, evaluation of DPR on merits including its financial viability etc. As such 
no confirmed timeframe for approval of estimate can be ascertained at this stage.

were being operated. Since November-2021, Express train services are being operated as per 
rationalized time table. Instructions have been issued for operation of passenger train services 
as per rationalized time table. As on 1 st August, 2022, 1916 Mail/Express services and 2362 
Passenger special services have been put in operation over various Divisions of Indian 
Railways.  Further more passenger trains are being restored in a phased manner, which is an 
ongoing process.  
Further, as a part of passenger amenities linen/blankets are provided in AC coaches of Indian 
Railways.  However, with the outbreak of COVID-19 pandemic, as precautionary measures, 
linen/blankets were discontinued in the trains.  Instructions for discontinuation of linen 
/curtains have been withdrawn.  Action has been initiated by Zonal Railways to start 
linen/blankets in phased manner.  Accordingly, Linen services have been provided in more 
than 80% of the identified trains.  Remaining trains are being covered in a phased manner.   
Ministry of Railways have issued instructions on 19.11.2021 to resume the services of 
cooked food in trains which had been discontinued due to pandemic.  Post pandemic, pantry 
car services have been resumed progressively.  Presently, more than 97% pantry car services 
have been resumed.  Passengers may avail of food through enroute catering units or order 
food of their choice through e-catering services.

STATEMENT REFERRED TO IN REPLY TO PARTS (a) TO (d) OF UNSTARRED QUESTION 
NO. 2384 BY SHRI SUSHIL KUMAR MODI  ANSWERED IN RAJYA SABHA ON 05.08.2022 
REGARDING RAILWAY INFRASTRUCTURE AND PASSENGER FACILITIES 
(a):  Railway Infrastructure projects are sanctioned Zonal Railway wise and not State-wise/district-
wise as Indian Railways’ Project may span State boundaries.  However, as on 01.04.2022, 52 
Railway Infrastructure projects (32 new lines, 04 gauge conversions and 16 doublings), costing 
₹66,597 crore, covering total length of 5,004 Km falling fully/partly in the State of Bihar are in 
different stages of planning/approval/execution, out of which 1,240 Km length has been 
commissioned and an expenditure of ₹21,038 crore has been incurred upto March, 2022. 
 
Projects in the State of Bihar are covered by East Central Railway (ECR), Eastern Railway (ER), 
North Eastern Railway (NER) and Northeast Frontier Railway (NFR) Zones of Indian Railways.  
The project-wise details including cost, expenditure and outlay are available in public domain on 
Indian Railways website i.e. www.indianrailways.gov.in> Ministry of Railways> Railway Board > 
About Indian Railways> Railway Board Directorates> Finance (Budget)> Pink Book 
(year)>Railways-wise Works, Machinery & Rolling Stock Programme (RSP). 
 
Since 2014, there has been substantial increase in Budget allocation and commensurate 
commissioning of projects. Average Annual Budget allocation for Infrastructure projects & safety 
works, falling fully/ partly in State of Bihar, during 2014-19 has been enhanced to 
₹ 3,061 crore per 
year from ₹ 1,132 crore per year during 2009-14, which is 170% more than Average Annual Budget 
allocation during 2009-14. These allocations have been increased to ₹ 4,093 crore in Financial Year 
2019-20 (262% more than the Average Annual Budget allocation of 2009-14), ₹ 4,489 crore in 
Financial Year 2020-21 (297% more than the Average Annual Budget allocation of 2009-14) 
and ₹ 5,560 crore in Financial Year 2021-22 (391% more than the Average Annual Budget Outlay of 
2009-14). For Financial Year 2022-23, highest ever Budget outlay of ₹ 6,606 crore has been 
provided for these projects, which is 484% more than the Average Annual Budget Outlay of 2009-14 
(₹ 1,132 crore per year).  
 
During 2014-22, 1096 Km length (317 Km New Lines, 425 Km Gauge Conversion and 354 Km 
Doubling) falling fully/partly in the State of Bihar have been commissioned at an average rate 137 
Km/year, which is 115% more than the commissioning during 2009-14 (63.6 Km/year Km).  
 
The details of allocation of funds and expenditure incurred for development and maintenance of 
stations are maintained Zonal Railway-wise and not station-wise or state-wise. There are 04 zones, 
namely, Eastern Railway, Northeast Frontier Railway, North Eastern Railway and East Central 
Railway, which cater to the State of Bihar. The details of funds allocated and expenditure incurred

435

STATEMENT REFERRE D TO IN REPLY TO PARTS (a) TO (d ) OF UNSTARRED 
QUESTION NO. 2386 BY SHRI DEEPENDER SINGH HOODA ANSWERED IN RAJYA 
SABHA ON 05.08.2022 REGARDING RAILWAY PROJECTS IN HARYANA. 
 
(a):  The Railway projects are sanctioned Zonal Railway -wise and not State -wise as the 
Railways’ projects may span across State boundaries .  During last five years i.e. 2017 -18 
onwards, connectivity between Palwal and New Prithala (3.5 km) project has been approved 
on 09.08.2021 and a new BG double line from Palwal to S onipat (Haryana Orbital Rail 
Corridor) (HORC) (121.742 km) project has been approved on 15.09.2020 falling fully/partly 
in Haryana. HORC is being executed by Haryana Rail Infrastructure Development 
Corporation Ltd. (HRIDC), a joint venture company of Govt.  of Haryana (51%) and Ministry 
of Railways (49%) through SPV named HORCL.  
Railway projects falling fully/partly in Haryana are covered under Northern Railway Zone  
and North Western Railway Zone of Indian Railways .  The details  of Railway projects 
including cost, expenditure and outlay are made available in public domain on Indian 
Railways website i.e.  www.indianrailways.gov.in> Ministry of Railways> Railway Board> 
about Indian Railways> Railway Board Directorates> Finance (Budget)> Pink Book (year)> 
Railway-wise Works, Machinery and Rolling Stock Programme (RSP). 
 
(b): For Railway infrastructure projects such as construction of New Lines, Gauge 
Conversion and Multi Tracking Works, acquisiti on of land including private land is done by 
the Railways through concerned State Governments.  The process of land acquisition for 
Railway projects is continuous and there is no centralized compendium of the details of the 
quantum/area of land including p rivate land acquired by the Railways for execution of 
various Railway projects across the country. 
 
(c) Completion of  Railway project s depends on various factors like expeditious land 
acquisition by State Government, forest clearance by officials of forest department, timely 
deposition of cost share by cost sharing authorities, shifting of infringing utilities, statutory 
clearances from various authorities, geological and topograp hical conditions of area, law and 
order s ituation in the area of project( s) site, number of working months in a year for 
particular project site etc. and all these factors affect the completion time of the project.  With 
above constraints every efforts is being made to execute the project expeditiously. 
(d) Proposals/demands for new railway lines, both formal as well as informal, are received 
from State Governments, Ministries of Central Government, elected representatives, 
organizations/Rail users etc. by Railways at various levels i.e. Railway Board, Zonal 
436

Railways and Divisional Headquarters, etc.   As receipt of such proposals/demands is a 
continuous and dynamic process, centralized compendium of such requests is not maintained.   
Haryana Rail Infrastruct ure Development Corporation (HRIDC) a joint venture company of 
Government of Haryana (51%) & Ministry of Railways (49%) has identified Karnal-
Yamunanagar new rail line project (65 Km) for development. Proposal is being firmed up 
with HRIDC.

2388  #  SHRI VIVEK THAKUR:

(b)   the steps being taken by Government for easy access for darshan of Lord Shri Ram and 
Mata Sita;  
 
(c) 
  whether  Government would run a direct train connecting Ayodhya and Sitamarhi for the 
devotees to visit the birthplace of Lord Shri Ram and Mata Sita in a single journey; and 
 
(d)   whether  Government run daily or weakly trains from the capital of each State directly to 
Ayodhya? 
     
ANSWER 
MINISTER OF RAILWAYS, COMMUNICATIONS AND 
ELECTRONICS & INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY 
(SHRI ASHWINI VAISHNAW)

Bharat Gaurav train on ‘Ramayana Circuit’ covering various destinations connected with 
Ramayana, including Ayodhya and Sitamarhi, in a 18 days tour operated between 21.06.2022 to 
08.07.2022. 
 
Indian Railways have issued the ‘Bharat Gaurav Trains’ policy with the objective to showcase 
India’s rich cultural heritage and magnificent historical places to the people of India and the 
world through Bharat Gaurav Trains. These are theme based tourist circuit trains. Under this

various parts of the country including capital cities like Delhi, Lucknow, Mumbai, Chennai 
Central, Guwahati and Ahmedabad etc. Besides, subject to operational feasibility, resource 
availability, traffic demand etc., introduction of new train services is an on-going process on 
Indian Railways.

DFCs.  The decision regarding sanctioning of any new Freight Corridor depends on many factors 
including outcome of the DPR, techno-economic feasibility, financial viability, financing 
arrangements etc.

STATEMENT REFERRED TO IN REPLY TO PARTS (a) TO (d) OF UNSTARRED QUESTION 
NO. 2391 BY SHRI K.R.N. RAJESHKUMAR ANSWERED IN RAJYA SABHA ON 05.08.2022 
REGARDING RECRUITMENT OF NON-EXECUTIVES AND OFFICERS BY RRB AND UPSC 
 
(a):  No, Sir.  
(b): Does 
not arise. 
(c): Direct Recruitment to Group ‘A’ Junior Scale posts of Assistant Manager (AM) in Indian 
Railway Management Service (IRMS) and Assistant Security Commissioner (ASC) in Indian Railway 
Protection Force Service (IRPFS) on Indian Railways is done through Civil Service Examination 
(CSE) conducted annually by UPSC. There is also a provision for Direct Recruitment to Group ‘A’ 
posts in miscellaneous cadres on Indian Railways viz. posts of Chemist and Metallurgists (Sr. Scale), 
Principal Railway Degree College (Academic Pay level 13 A), Sr. Rajbhasha Officers (Sr. Scale) and 
Senior Managers (Printing and Stationery) (Sr. Scale); recruitment to which is not resorted to on 
annual basis. 
Direct Recruitment to Group ‘A’ Junior Scale posts of Assistant Div isional Medical officer (ADMO) 
in Indian Railway Health Service (IRHS) is done through Combined Medical Services Examination 
(CMSE) conducted annually by UPSC. 
There is also a provision for Direct Recruitment of Assistant Divisional Dental Surgeon (in Junior 
Scale), Specialist Divisional Medical Officer (in Senior Scale) and Super Specialist Senior Divisional 
Medical Officer (in Junior Administrative Grade) through UPSC which is not an annual exercise and 
is resorted to only as per requirements of the speciality in the Organisation. 
Direct recruitment to fill various Group 'C non-gazetted posts viz. Assistant Loco Pilots (ALP), 
Technicians, Senior Section Engineers, Junior Engineers, Non-Technical Popular Categories (NTPC) 
(Graduate & Undergraduate posts- Station Masters, Goods Train Manager , Senior Clerk cum Typist, 
Commercial Cum Ticket Clerk  etc.), Paramedical Categories, Ministerial & Isolated Categories and 
Level 1 (erstwhile Group ‘D’) posts on the Indian Railways is made thr ough Railway Recruitment 
Boards (RRBs). Railway Recruitment Cells (RRCs) are also involved in the recruitment to Level -I 
categories. 
Recruitment is also made by the Zonal Railways and Production Units etc.
, without going through the 
agency of the Railway Recruitment Board, of sons/daughters/ wives/ wards etc. of Railway servants 
who die while in service or retire after medical incapacitation in accordance with the general orders 
which may be issued by the Ministry of Railways from time to time. Similarly, appointments are also 
made of outstanding sportsmen and of persons having qualifications in the field of culture and 
Scouting/ Guiding against the respective annual quotas prescribed for these purposes and on the 
conditions laid down from time to time in  the general orders  issued 
by the Ministry of Railways. 
(d): Apart from appointments on Compassionate grounds, Sports quota appointment under Talent 
Scouting Scheme, no other recruitments were made in Southern Railway – Tamil Nadu State without 
involvement of RRB and UPSC.

STATEMENT REFERRED TO IN REPLY TO PARTS (a) TO (d) OF UNSTARRED

(a) to (d) Yes, Sir. Ministry of Railways has formulated various schemes viz. Model, Modern 
and Adarsh Station Scheme for upgradation/beautificationof stations on Indian Railways. 
Presently, Railway stations are upgraded/beautified under ‘Adarsh’ Station Scheme based on 
identified need of providing better enha nced passenger amenities at stations. Under ‘Adarsh’ 
Station Scheme, 1253 stations have been identified for development, out of which 1215 
stations so far have been developed and the remaining stations are targeted to be developed 
under Adarsh Station Scheme by Financial Year 2022-23. Besides above, a new scheme for 
‘Major Upgradation of Railway Stations' has been recently initiated. So far, 52 stations have 
been identified for upgradation under this scheme.  
 
The expenditure on beautification/upgradation of stations under Adarsh Station Scheme is 
generally funded under Plan Head –53 ‘Customer Amenities’. During the Financial Year 2021-
22, an amount of 
₹ 2344.55crore was allocated under Plan Head -53, and in the current 
Financial Year 2022-23, an amount of ₹ 2700.00 crore has been allocated under Plan Head - 
53. 
 
There are 32 Stations which were identified under Adarsh Station Scheme in the State of 
Gujarat. All 32 stations have been developed under the Adarsh Station Scheme. The names of 
stations located in the state of Gujarat identified for development under ‘Adarsh’ Station 
Scheme are as under:-

UNSTARRED QUESTION NO-2397 
ANSWERED ON- 05/08/2022 
 
PENDING PAYMENT UNDER TUFS 
 
2397. SHRI SANJEEV ARORA: 
 
Will the Minister of TEXTILES be pleased to state:  
 
 
(a) how much disbursement is pending to textile industry under Technology Upgradation Fund Scheme  
(TUFS); and  
 
(b) by when this outstanding amount is expected to be disbursed?  
 
 
 
 
ANSWER 
 
THE MINISTER OF STATE FOR TEXTILES  
(SMT. DARSHANA JARDOSH) 
 
(a) & (b): Actual amount of subsidy to be disbursed under Amended Technology Upgradation 
Fund Scheme (ATUFS) and its older versions is arrived at after confirming the admissibility of the 
claim through verification of assets. As per scheme guidelines of ATUFS, installation and 
commissioning of the machinery shall be done by the applicant within 2 years from date of sanction of 
term loan. Out of 14,391 cases registered under ATUFS till approved tenure i.e. upto 31.03.2022, 
request for asset verification has been received in 10,994 cases, of which 9,014 cases have been verified 
by Joint Inspection Team. After verification and computing of eligible subsidy, a total of 6,599 cases 
have been settled with release of Rs.1,192 crore.  Under liability cases of older versions of ATUFS, out 
of 888 cases verified, 180 cases have been settled with the release of subsidy value amounting 
Rs.360.85 crore. Settlement of outstanding cases is ongoing as per guidelines and a total of      
Rs.111.24 crore has been disbursed during the current Financial Year. Ministry has taken various 
measures for expeditious settlement of cases such as, streamlining of procedures, setting up of field 
level camps, decision for graded/ automated verification of assets.

4. नवजयमोनहनी नमलस नतरुवनरतपःरम  
 
 उपरोक्त के अ ावा, एनटीसी के पास केर  में पावतती नमलस, कि ोन नामक भी एक नम  है नजसका 
पःनरुद्धार सरयःक्त उद्यम (जेवी) मागत के माध्यम से होने की उम् मीद है। वषत 2008 में पावतती नमलस सनहत 
एनटीसी की 11 नम क के सरबरध में जेवी भागीदारक के साथ हस्‍तताक्षररत समझौता ज्ञापन (एमओयू) सरयःक्त उद्यम 
भागीदारक द्वारा ननदिषदट स समय में एनटीसी के साथ नननित  समझौता करने में नवफ  होने के कारण कदनारक    
14 जनवरी , 2010 को समाप्त कर कदया गया था। माचत, 2020 से कोनवड-19 महामारी और नवनभन्न राज्य 
सरकारक द्वारा  गाए गए राष्ट्रव्यापी  ॉकडाउन के कारण केर  राज्य में नम क सनहत सभी राष्ट्रीय वस्‍त र ननगम 
(एनटीसी) की नम क में उत्पादन गनतनवनधयक को बरद कर कदया गया था। कःछ एनटीसी नम क में जनवरी, 
2021 से सामान्य सरचा न कफर से शःरू ककया गया था, नजसे कायतशी  पूरजी की अनःप ब्धता और अन्य 
नवत्तीय बाधा क के कारण जारी नहक रखा जा सका।  
 
(ख) और (ग):  जैसा कक ऊपर (क) के उत्तर में बताया गया है, एनटीसी नम क की ननररतर खराब आर्थथक 
व्यवहायतता को ध् यान में रखते एए, वस्‍त र मररा य नीनत आयोग और सावतजननक उद्यम नवभाग, नवत् त मररा य 
के परामशत से इस माम े में आगे बढ़ने के न ए एक कायत योजना तैयार कर रहा है।  
 
(घ) और  (ङ): एनटीसी नम क के श्रनमकक को नम  के प्रबरधन और प्रनतनननधत्व करने वा े कामगारक के बीच 
आपसी समझौते के अनःसार मजदूरी और वैधाननक बकाया का भःगतान ककया जा रहा है।

क␀ खेती के ␀े␀ म␀ व ृ␀␀ ह ुई है। ए␀सड लाइम का ␀े␀फल वष␀ 2018-19 म␀ 38,234 हे␀टेयर से 
बढ़कर वष␀ 2020-21 म␀ 43,044 हे␀टेयर हो गया है। इसी तरह , ␀वीट ऑर␀ज का ␀े␀फल वष␀ 
2018-19 म␀ 85,784 हे␀टेयर से बढ़कर वष␀ 2020-21 म␀ 1 ,10,970 हे␀टेयर हो गया है।

योजना के तहत ␀कए गए काय␀ का रा␀य-वार ␀यौरा ␀या है ;  
 
(ख) ␀वगत तीन वष␀ म␀ इस योजना के ␀लए आबं␀टत , जार␀ तथा खच␀ क␀ गई धनरा␀श का रा␀य-वार 
␀यौरा ␀या है ; 
 
(ग)  इस योजना के तहत ␀␀ता␀वत/चल रह␀ प␀रयोजनाओं का रा␀य-वार ␀वशेषकर महारा␀␀ का ␀ यौरा 
␀या है ; और 
 
(घ)  ␀या सरकार इस योजना को शेष रा␀य␀ म␀ लाग ू करने पर ␀वचार कर रह␀ है , य␀द हां, तो त␀संबंधी 
␀यौरा ␀या है , और य␀द नह␀ं, तो इसके ␀या कारण ह␀?

और मू␀ य आयोग (सीएसीपी) को भेजे जाते ह␀ जो इसे भारत सरकार को ␀ य ू

(ख):  ␀वगत तीन वष␀ म␀ इस योजना के तहत आवं␀टत , जार␀ और ␀ यय क␀ गई ␀न␀ध का रा␀ य-वार 
␀ यौरा अनुबंध म␀ ␀दया गया है। 
 
(ग):  डेटा का एक␀ीकरण और संकलन महारा␀ ␀ स␀हत 19 रा␀ य␀ म␀ ␀नरंतर चलने वाल␀ ␀␀␀या है।

␀लए 9.5% का उप-ल␀य छोटे और सीमांत ␀कसान␀ (एसएमएफ) के ␀लए ␀नधा␀␀रत ␀कया गया

क्‍या क ृ षि एवं षकसान  कल्‍याण मंत्ऱी यह बताने  क़ी क ृ पा कर ें गे षक :  
(क) क ृ षि लागत  में कमी  लाने  के  षलए सरकार द्वारा कार्ाान्‍षित की  जा  रही र्ोजनाओं के

(ख) उक्‍त  र्ोजना हेतु  षकतना  बजट आिंषटत षकर्ा गर्ा है तथा  षिगत पां च ििों के  दौरान 
उन  पर षकतनी  धनराषि खचा की  गई है; 
(ग) उक्‍त  र्ोजनाओं से षकतने  षकसान  लाभान्‍षित हुए हैं और तत्‍संबंधी ब्‍र्ौरा क्‍र्ा है; और  
(घ) इन  र्ोजनाओं के  कार्ाान्‍िर्न से क ृ षि लागत  में प्रषत हैक्‍टर षकतनी  कमी  आई तथा  
षकसानों  की  आर् षकतनी  बढी , षिगत पांच  ििों के  दौरान तत्‍संबंधी ििा-िार ब्‍र्ौरा क्‍र्ा 
है?

(क )्‍से्‍(घ): सरकार्‍ने ्‍खेती ्‍की ्‍लागत ्‍को ्‍कम ्‍करने ्‍के ्‍षलए्‍कई ्‍कदम ्‍उठाए ्‍हैं्‍जैसे-र्ूररर्ा्‍और्‍

प्रबंधन्‍र्ोजना ,्‍क ृ षि्‍र्ंत्रीकरण्‍उप्‍षमिन ्‍के ्‍माध्यम्‍से्‍कस्टम्‍हार्रर ं ग्‍क ें द्ों्‍की ्‍स्थापना ,्‍र ि ोन्‍सषहत ्‍

2258. श्ऱीमत़ी शांता क्षत्ऱी: 
क् या क ृषि एवं ककसान कल् याण मंत्ऱी यह बताने की कृपा करेंगे कक:  
(क ) मंत्रालय द्वारा पहाड़ी क्षेत्रों में खेत़ी के ललए लसंचाई प्रणाली के आधुतनकीकरण एवं षवकास  हेत ु क् या 
कदम उठाए  गए हैं; 
(ख) क् या मंत्रालय इस बात को मानता है  कक पहाड़ी क्षेत्रों में लसंचाई के अलग-अलग तौर -तरीके  हैं, और 
इसललए इन क्षेत्रों पर गौर करने के ललए एक अलग षवभाग की तत् का ल आवश् यकता है ; और 
(ग) यदद  हां, तो तत् संबंध़ी ब् यौरा क् या है और यदद नहीं , तो इसके क् या कारण हैं ? 
 
उत् तर 
क ृषि एवं ककसान कल् याण मंत्ऱी (श्ऱी नरेन्‍द र लसंह तोमर)  
 
(क) से (ग):  भारत स रका र विथ 2015 -16 से प्रधानमंत्ऱी कृषि लसंचाई योजना (प़ीएमकेएसवाई) का  
कायाथन्‍द वयन कर रही है  जो पहाड़ी इलाकों सदहत देश में खेत़ी के ललए लसंचाई प्रणाली के आध ुतनकीकरण 
और षवकास में योगदान दे त़ी है। प़ीएमकेएसवाई के घटक इस प्रकार हैं: 
i. त्वररत लसंचाई लाभ कायथक्रम (एआईब़ीप़ी): जल संसाधन, नदी षवकास एवं गंगा संरक्षण षवभाग 
द्वारा कायाथन्न्‍दवत ककया जाता है । 
ii. हर खेत को पाऩी ( एचकेकेप़ी): जल संसाधन , नदी षवकास एवं गंगा संरक्षण षवभाग द्वारा 
कायाथन्न्‍दवत ककया जाता है । 
iii. पनधारा  षवकास घटक (डब्ल्यूड़ीस़ी): भू-संसाधन षवभाग द्वारा कायाथन्न्‍दवत कक या जाता है । 
        क ृषि एवं ककसान कल्याण षवभाग (ड़ीएएंडएफडब्ल्यू) देश में प्रतत बू
ंद अधधक फसल (प़ीड़ीएमस़ी) 
योजना का  कायाथन्‍द वयन कर  रहा है जो विथ 2015-16 से 2021-22 तक प़ीएमकेएसवाई का एक घटक 
र्ा। विथ 2022-23 के दौरान , प़ीड़ीएमस़ी को राष्ट्रीय कृषि षवकास योजना (आरकेव़ीवाई) के तहत 
कायाथन्न्‍द वत  ककया जा रहा है। प़ीड़ीएमस़ी योजना के तहत सूक्ष्म लसंचाई प्रणाली अर्ाथत ड्रिप और न्स्प्रंकलर 
लसंचाई प्रणाली की स्र्ापना हेत ु छोटे और स़ीमांत ककसानों के ललए 55%  की दर से और अन्‍दय ककसानों 
के ललए 45% की दर से  षवत्त़ीय सहायता प्रदान की जात़ी है। सूक्ष्म लसंचाई के महत्व को  समझते ह ुए 
और ककसानों द्वारा इसे बडे पैमाने पर अपनाए  जाने के ललए प ूवोत्तर और दहमालय़ी राज्यों के ललए 
राजसहायता  की गणना में 25% अधधक इकाई लागत ली  गई है। 
 इन योजनाओं के तहत , पूवोत्तर और दहमालय़ी राज्यों के ललए क ें र और राज्य के ब़ीच 90:10 के 
अनुपात में उदार षवत्त पोिण पद्धतत का अनुपालन ककया जाता है।  
 इसके अलावा , भारत़ीय जल प्रबंधन संस्र्ान, भुवनेश्वर और पहाड़ी क्षेत्रों में न्स्र्त लसंचाई जल 
प्रबंधन से संबंधधत  अखखल भारत़ीय समन्न्‍दवत अनुसंधान  पररयोजना क ें रों (एआईस़ीआरप़ी) के माध्यम से 
भारत़ीय कृषि अनुसंधान पररिद (आईस़ीएआर) इन क्षेत्रों में फसलों के ललए जल संसाधनों के षवकास और 
संचयन तर्ा लसंचाई सुषवधाओं के  सृजन के  संबंध में  काम कर रही है। इसके अलावा , आईस़ीएआर- 
भारत़ीय मृदा एवं जल संरक्षण संस्र्ान, दे हराद ून दहमालय व लशवाललक क्षेत्र, पन्श्चम़ी घाट व पूवी घाट में 
खेत़ी और मृदा -जल संरक्षण की जरूरतों को प ूरा कर रहा है।

(क) : सरकार देश में जैषवक खेती को बढावा दे ने के ललए विथ 2015 -16 से पूवोत्तर क्षेत्र में परम्परागत कृषि 
षवकास योजना (पीकेवीवाई) और जैषवक म ूल्य श्रृंखला षवकास लमशन (एमओवीसीडीएनईआर) की समषपथ त जैषवक 
क ृषि स्कीमों का  कायाथ ‍ वयन  कर रही है। इन स्कीमों के  तहत  ककसानों को म ुख्य रूप से जैषवक खाद सहहत 
षवलभ‍न जैषवक आदानों का उपयोग करके  जैषवक खेती को अपनाने के  ललए प्रोत्साहहत ककया जाता है और उ‍हें 
जैषवक उत्पाद के उत्पादन से लेकर षवपणन तक समग्र सहायता प्रदान की जाती है। जैषवक खाद और जैव 
उवथरकों के ऑन -फामथ उत्पादन और इसके  उपयोग के बारे में ककसानों को प्रांरलभक प्रलशक्षण देना इन योजनाओं 
का अलभ‍न अंग है।  
सरकार षवलभ‍न स्कीमों के माध्यम से जैषवक खाद के  उत्पादन और उपयोग के  ललए ककसानों को 
प्रोत्साहहत कर रही है जैसा कक अन ुबंध -I में हदया गया है।  
(ख): भारतीय क ृषि अन ुसंधान  पररिद (आईसीएआर)  द्वारा ककए गए जैषवक और पा रंपररक प्रबंधन के

रबी/ग्रीष्मकालीन फसलों के दौरान  पैदावार दीर्ाथवधध जैषवक प्रबंधन दृ न्ष्टकोणों के  अंतगथत इन प्रणाललयों की 
बेहतर उपय ुक्तता को दशाथते ह ुए अजैषवक  दृन्ष्टकोणों की तुलना में पैदावार अधधक पाई गई र्ी। मोटे चावल , 
बासमती चावल और सोयाबीन -आधाररत प्रणाललयों के  ललए दीर्थकाललक जैषवक  दृन्ष्टकोण के  तहत मृदा जैषवक  
काबथन को काफी अधधक पाया गया र्ा।

उत् पादकता का फसल -वार, विथ-वार और राज् य -वार ब् यौरा अनुबांध में ददया गया है। फसलों की उत् पा दकता 
(पैदावार  प्रतत हेक् टेयर) ककसानों की आय क े  ललए एक महत् वपूणथ  कारक है । लसंचाई क े  स् तरों में अंतर , मौसम 
एवं ताप क्रम की दशाएं , संसाधन संवधथन , क ृ षि का मशीनीकरण , भू-जोत आकार आदद क े  कारण म ुख् य फसलों 
की उत् पादकता में अंतराथज् यी य लभन्द् नताएं पाई जाती हैं।  
 
फसलों की उत् पा दकता क ृ षि क्षेत्र में सकल म ूल् यवधथन का एक म ुख् य तनधाथरकहै। क ृ षि आदानों की 
समय पर उपलब् ध ता और उपयोग की उधचत पद्धतत फसल उत् पा दकता बढाने क े  ललए महत् व पूणथ है। दे श में 
ककसानों को ररयायती दरों पर बीजों , उवथरकों , क ृ षि मशीनर  और उपकरणों , लसंचाई स ुषवधाओं , संस् र्ागत ऋण 
आदद की आप ूततथ क े  ललए सरकार षवलभन्द् न योजनाओं का कायाथन्द् वयन कर रह  है।  
 
इसक े  अलावा , सरकार ने क ृ षि क्षेत्र में तनवेश बढाने क े  ललए कई उपाय ककए हैं जजनमें  क ृ षि 
अवसंरचना तनधध (एआईएफ) , द घाथवधध लसंचाई तनधध (एलट आईएफ) का स ृजन , जल उपयोग दक्षता क े  ललए 
सूक्ष् म लसंचाई तनधध , वाणणजज् यक जैषवक खेती को बढावा देना आदद शालमल हैं । इसक े  अततररक् त , संशोधधत 
राष्‍ट र य क ृ षि षवकास योजना  (आरक े वीवाई) अर्ाथत आरक े वीवाई-आरएएफट एएआर  (क ृ षि एवं संबद्ध क्षेत्र क े  
पुनरूद्धार क े  ललए लाभकार  उपागम) क े  तहत , तनयलमत पररव् यय का 50 प्रततशत अवसंरचना एवं 
पररसंपजत् तयों क े  ललए तनधाथररत ककया गया है।

(क ) एवं (ख): भारत सरकार ने षपछले पांच विों के  दौरान ककसी भी क ृषि ऋण माफी योजना को 
कियास्न्‍द वत नहीं ककया है। कभी -कभी  राज्य सरकारें अपने स्वयं के ननणथयों के अन ुसार अपने 
स्वयं के संसाधनों से कृषि ऋण माफी की घोिणा करती हैं  और लाभार्र्थयों का डेटा आदद केवल 
संबंर्धत राज्य सरकारों के पास रहता है।

ददया गया  है।

भारत सरकार  
कृषि एवं ककसान कल् याण मंत्रालय 
कृषि एवं ककसान कल् याण षवभाग  
राज्‍ य‍सभा  
अताराांकित‍प्रश्‍ न‍सां.‍2284 
5 अगस् त, 2022 को उत् तरार्थ 
 
विषय:‍प्रधानमांत्री-किसान‍योजना‍िा‍िायाान्‍ ियन 
2284. श्री समीर उरांव: 
क्या कृषि एवं ककसान कल्याण मंत्री यह बताने की कृपा करेंगे ककिः 
 
(क) प्रधानमंत्री ककसान सम् मान ननधध -योजना  (पीएम-ककसान) के तहत ककतने ज़रूरत मंद 
ककसानों को लाभ प्रदान ककया जा रहा है , तत् संबंधी राज् य-वार ब् यौरा क् या है; 
(ख) क् या सरकार ने पीएम -ककसान योजना के ललए ई -केवाईसी को अननवायथ कर ददया है ;  
(ग) यदद हां, तो तत् संबंधी ब् यौरा क् या है;    
(घ) क् या सरकार को उक् त योजना का अन ुधित लाभ उठाने संबंधी मामलों की जानकारी है ; 
और  
(ङ) यदद हां, तो ऐसे ककतने लोग हैं जो उक् त योजना का अन ुधित तरीके से लाभ ले रहे हैं और 
सरकार द्वारा ऐसे लोगों के षवरुद्ध क् या का रथवाई की जा रही है ? 
 
उत्‍ तर 
कृषि एवं ककसान कल् याण मंत्री (श्री नरेन्‍द र लसंह तोमर) 
 
(क ) योजना  की श ुरुआत से 28/07/2022 तक  पीएम-ककसान  के तहत लाभान्न्‍दवत होने वाले पात्र 
लाभाधर्थयों की संख्या और षवलभन्‍दन ककश्तों के माध्यम से उन्‍दहें जारी की गई  धन रालश का 
राज्य-वार षववरण अन ुबंध में है।  
 
(ख) एवं (ग) सरकार ने पीएम -ककसान योजना के सभी लाभाधर्थयों के ललए ई -केवाईसी अननवायथ 
कर ददया है। ककसान पीएम -ककसान पोर्थल और पीएम -ककसान ऐप पर वन -र्ाइम पासवर्थ 
(ओर्ीपी) मोर् का उपयोग करके अपना ई -केवाईसी प ूरा कर सकते हैं। इसके अलावा , ककसा नों  
को बायोमेदिक ई -केवाईसी की स ुषवधा भी सामान्‍दय सेवा केंरों (सीएससी) के माध्यम से प्रदान 
की गई है।    
 
(घ) एवं (ङ) केंरीय क्षेत्र की सबसे बडी योजनाओं में से एक, पीएम ककसान सम्मान ननधध (पीएम -
ककसान) को देश के भ ू-जोत धारक ककसानों की षवत्तीय आवश् यकताओं  को प ूरा करने के ललए 
कियान्न्‍द वत ककया जा रहा है। योजना के तहत ककसानों के बैंक खातों में 6000/- रुपये प्रनत विथ 
का षवत्तीय लाभ तीन समान ककश्तों में अंतररत ककया जाता है।  
 
618

अब तक , 11.37 करोड पात्र ककसानों को पीएम ककसान के तहत 2 लाख करोड  रुपये से अधधक 
का भ ुगतान ककया जा ि ुका है।  
  
 योजना के  लाभ ककसान पररवारों को ददए  जाते हैं। संबंधधत राज्य/संघ राज्य क्षेत्र की भू-
अलभलेख  प्रणाली के अनुसार पररवार के पास क ृषि योग्य भूलम होनी िादहए। लाभार्ी की म ृत्यु
 
के कारण उत्तराधधकार के मामले को छोडकर , भूलम के स्वालमत्व की अंनतम नतधर् 1 फरवरी 2019 
है। उच्ि आधर्थक न्स्र्नत वाली  कुछ श्रेणणयों जैसे कक संवैधाननक पदों के प ूवथ और वतथमान 
धारक ; पूवथ और वतथमान मंत्री/सांसद/षवधायक ; सभी अधधवषिथता /सेवाननव ृत्त पेंशनभोगी न्जनकी 
मालसक पेंशन 10,000/- रुपये या अधधक है ; केंर / राज्य सरकार या सावथजननक उपिमों के सभी 
सेवारत या सेवाननव ृत्त कमथिारी (मल्र्ी-र्ान्स्कंग स्र्ाफ / ितुर्थ श्रेणी / समू
ह र्ी कमथिाररयों को 
छोडकर) ; षपछले ननधाथरण विथ में आयकर का भ ुगतान करने वाले सभी व्यन्क्त; व् यावसानयक  
ननकायों के सार् पंजीक ृत र्ॉक्र्र, इंजीननयर , वकील , िार्थर्थ एकाउंर्ेंर् और आककथर्ेक्र् जैसे 
व् यवसायी; और अननवासी भारतीय  को योजना के तहत लाभ प्राप्त करने से बाहर रखा गया है। 
 
  राज्य/संघ राज्य क्षेत्र, योजना के तहत लाभाधर्थयों की पहिान और सत्यापन करते हैं। 
पीएम-ककसान  पोर्थल पर राज्यों / संघ राज्य क्षेत्रों से प्राप्त सत्याषपत आंकडों के आधार पर, 
प्रत्यक्ष लाभ अंतरण मोर् के माध्यम से लाभाधर्थयों को लाभ अंतररत कक ए जाते हैं। लाभाधर्थयों 
के र्ेर्ा के स्विाललत सत्यापन में राज्यों / संघ राज् य क्षेत्र की सहायता के ललए , आधार 
प्रमाणीकरण के ललए पीएम -ककसान पोर्थल को भारतीय षव लशष्र् पहिान प्राधधकरण 
(यूआईर्ीएआई) के ; खाते और सरकारी कमथिाररयों/पेंशनभोधगयों के र्ेर्ा के सत्यापन के ललए 
सावथजननक षवत्त प्रबंधन प्रणाली (पीएफएमएस) के ; आयकर दाता की न्स्र्नत के सत्यापन के 
ललए आयकर षवभाग के ; और खाता सत्यापन और आधार आधाररत भ ुगतान के ललए भारतीय 
राष्िीय भुगतान ननगम (एनपीसीआई) के पोर्थलों के सार् समेककत  ककया गया है।  
 
पात्र ककसानों का नामांकन ककया जा रहा है और म ृतक / अपात्र लाभाधर्थयों को लाभार्ी 
के र्ेर्ा के ननरंतर सत्यापन और वैधीकरण  के माध्यम से हर्ाया जा रहा है। राज्यों / संघ 
राज् य क्षेत्रों को सत्यापन के बाद लाभाधर्थयों को पात्र से अपात्र और अपात्र से पात्र के रूप में 
धिन्ननत करने का षवकल्प प्रदान ककया गया है। राज्यों/संघ राज् य क्षेत्रों को सभी पात्र लाभाधर्थयों 
के सार् योजना की संत ृन्प्त और अपात्र लाभाधर्थयों को हर्ाने की प्रकिया में तेजी लाने के ललए 
कहा गया है।  
 कुछ ऐसे मामले सामने आए हैं जहां अपात्र व्यन्क्तयों को भुगतान ककया गया है। 
संबंधधत राज्य सरकारों द्वारा फजी लाभाधर्थयों से वसूली भी की गई है।

भारत  सरकार  
वाणिज्य और  उद्योग मंत्रालय 
उद्योग संवर्धन और  आंतररक  व्यापार णवभाग 
राज्य सभा 
अतारांणकत  प्रश्‍न संख्या: 2288 
शुक्रवार, 05 अगस्त, 2022 को उत्तर णिए जाने  के णलए 
 
णवशाखापट्टनम-चेन्नई औद्योणगक गणलयार े की स्थिणत 
 
2288. श्री कनकमेिला रवी ं द्र क ु मार: 
 श्री मथिान राव  बीडा: 
 
 क्या  वाणिज्य और  उद्योग मंत्री यह बताने  की  क ृ पा  करेंगे  कक : 
 
(क ) क्या  आंध्र प्रदेश सरकार  ने किशाखापट्टनम-चेन्नई औद्योकगक गकियारा  (िीसीआईसी) पररयोजना  के  तहत 
औद्योकगक आसंकियों और  समूह हेतु आिश्यक  भूकम अकिगृहीत कर  क ें द्र सरकार  को  स ंप दी है; 
(ख) यकद हााँ, तो तत्संबंिी ब्य रा  क्या  है; 
(ग) क्या  सरकार  ने िीसीआईसी पररयोजना  को  पूरा  करने  हेतु कोई  समय-सीमा  कनिााररत  की  है; 
(घ) यकद हााँ, तो तत्संबंिी ब्य रा  क्या  है; 
(ङ) यकद नहीं, इसक े  क्या  कारण  हैं; और  
(च) िीसीआईसी पररयोजना  पर  अब तक  क ु ि ककतना  बजट आिंकटत और  उपयोग ककया  गया  है? 
उत्तर  
वाणिज्‍य और  उद्योग मंत्रालय में राज्य मंत्री 
(श्री सोम प्रकाश) 
(क) से (च): किशाखापट्टनम-चेन्नई औद्योकगक कॉररडोर  (िीसीआईसी) के  तहत तीन नोड्स  नामत :, ( i) 
किशाखापट्टनम  (ii) कचत्तूर (श्रीक िाहस्ती)  (iii) कड़पा  (कोपर्थी)  किकास  के  किए कचकित 
ककए  गए हैं। राज्य  सरकार  ने स्वयं एकशयाई  किकास  बैंक  (एडीबी) की  कित्तीय सहायता  के  सार्थ 
किशाखापट्टनम नोड का  किकास  काया  शुरू  ककया  है। कचत्तूर (श्रीक िाहस्ती) और  कड़पा  (कोपर्थी) 
नोड के  संबंि में मास्टर  प्लाकनंग और  प्रारंकभक  इंजीकनयररंग  सकहत पररयोजना  किकास  संबंिी 
कायाकिापों  के  किए 3.13 करोड़ रुपए  आिंकटत और  इस्तेमाि ककए  गए हैं।  
 राज्य  सरकार  ने पररयोजना  के  किए भूकम उपिब्ध नहीं कराई  है। भूकम स ंपे जाने  के  बाद  
पररयोजना  को  पूरा  करने  की  समय-सीमा  कनिााररत  की  जा  सकती  है।

भारतीय  स्टार्धअप पररवेश  में नौकररयों  का नुकसान 
 
2289. श्री प्रमोि णतवारी :  
 
क्या वाणिज्य और  उद्योग मंत्री यह बताने की  क ृ पा  कर ें गे  कक: 
 
(क ) क्या क्र ं चबेस की  ररपोर्ट में इस  बात पर  प्रकाश डाला गया है कक वर्ट 2022 में तकनीकी  और  
स्टार्टअप क्षेत्र में 22,000 से  अकिक कामगारों  ने अपनी  नौकरी  खो दी है, साथ  ही 12000 से  अकिक 
कामगारों  ने भारतीय  स्टार्टअप  पररवेश  में अपनी  नौकरी  खो दी है; 
(ख) क्या ररपोर्ट बताती है कक भारत  के  स्टार्टअप क्षेत्र में मात्र वर्ट 2022 में 60,000 से  अकिक नौकररयों  
का  नुकसान  हो सकता  है; और  
(ग) क्या कवगत दो वर्ों में 15 प्रकतशत स्टार्टअप बंद हो गए हैं? 
 
उत्तर  
वाणिज्‍य और  उद्योग मंत्रालय में राज्य मंत्री 
(श्री सोम प्रकाश) 
(क): स्‍र्ार्टअप्‍स  द्वारा लोगों को  नौकररयों  से  हर्ाए जाने संबंिी  जानकारी  क ें द्रीय स्‍तर  पर  समेककत  नही ं 
की  जाती है। 
(ख): उपयुटक्‍त के  मद्द ेनजर प्रश्‍न नही ं उठता। 
(ग): ऐसी  जानकारी  क ें द्रीय स्‍तर  पर  समेककत  नही ं की  जाती।

(क ) पीएमगकत शक्ति राष्ट् र ीय मास्टर  प्लान के  आर ं भ होने के  बाद से इसक े  तहत उठाए गए कदमों  का  वर्ष -
वार  ब्यौरा  क्या  है; 
(ख) इस योजना के  किए जारी  की  गई कनकि का  वर्ष -वार  ब्यौरा  क्या  है; 
(ग) क्या  इस योजना की  शुरूआत  से इसक े  साथ जुडे 21 मंत्राियों के  साथ इस योजना में ककसी  नए मंत्रािय 
को  भी जोडा गया हैं, यकद हााँ, तो तत्संबंिी ब्यौरा  क्या  है; और  
(घ) कवगत  पााँच वर्ों  के  दौरान  सरकार  द्वारा अंतर -कवभागीय  दक्षता  में सुिार  िाने हेतु क्या  कदम  उठाए गए 
हैं? 
 
उत्तर  
वाणिज्‍य और  उद्योग मंत्रालय में राज्य मंत्री 
(श्री सोम प्रकाश) 
(क) से (घ): सरकार  ने कवकभन्न आकथषक  जोन में मल्टीमॉडि कनेक्तिकवटी  अवसंरचना  के  कवकास  के  किए 
अिूबर , 2021 में पीएम गकतशक्ति राष्ट् र ीय मास्टर  प्लान (एनएमपी) की  शुरूआत  की  है। पीएम 
गकतशक्ति एनएमपी प्रौद्योकगकी समकथषत जीआईएस प्लेटफॉमष है जो एकीक ृ त  आयोजना, 
समक्तित कायाषियन  और  पररयोजना  कनगरानी  के  किए आंकडा  आिाररत  कनर्षय  प्रकिया में 
सहायता करता  है। अिूबर , 2021 से, संबंकित क ें द्रीय  मंत्राियों/कवभागों  के  900 से अकिक  
डाटा िेयसष को  एनएमपी पर  अपिोड ककया  गया है। आवश्यक  डाटा िेयसष, कस्टमाइज्ड ट ू ल्स 
और  कायों  के  साथ सभी संबंकित क ें द्रीय  मंत्राियों और  राज्य  सरकारों  के  किए अिग-अिग 
पोटषि बनाए गए हैं। पीएम गकतशक्ति कोई  स्कीम  नहीं है, इसकिए इसक े  तहत को ई कनकि 
आवंकटत  नहीं की  जाती है। हािांकक  कवत्त मंत्रािय, व्यय कवभाग  ने 6 अप्रैि, 2022 को  ‘वर्ष  
2022-23 के  किए पूंजी कनवेश  हेतु राज्यों  को  कवशेर्  सहायता स्कीम ’ संबंिी कदशा-कनदेश जारी  
ककए  हैं। स्कीम  के  भाग-।। का  उद्द े श्य राज्यों  में पीएम गकत शक्ति संबंिी कनवे श में सहायता 
करना  है। स्कीम  के  भाग-।। के  किए 5000 करोड  रूपये  की  राकश  कनिाषररत  की  गई है। राज्यों  
को  कदशा-कनदेशों के  बार े  में संवेदनशीि बनाया गया है तथा वे  स्कीम  के  तहत कनिीयन प्राप्त

करने  के  किए आवश्यक  शतों का  अनुपािन करने  की  प्रकिया से गुजर  रहे  हैं। वतषमान  में, क ें द्र  
सरकार  के  23 मंत्रािय/कवभाग  पीएम गकत शक्ति का  कहस्सा हैं कजनका  ब्यौरा  नीचे कदया गया है: 
1. र े ि मंत्रािय; 2. सडक  पररवहन  एवं  राजमागष  मंत्रािय; 3. पत्तन, पोत पररवहन  और  जिमागष

उद्योग संविषन और  आंतररक  व्‍यापार  कवभाग ; 15. खाद्य और  सावषजकनक  कवतरर्  कवभाग ; 16.

पीएम गकत शक्ति राष्ट् र ीय मास्टर  प्लान कवकभन्न मंत्राियों/कवभागों   से संबंकित सभी अवसंरचना  
पररयोजनाओं  से युि  साझा प्लेटफॉमष के  कनमाषर्  में सहायता करता  है कजसे क ु शि आयोजना 
तथा वास्तकवक  समय आिार  पर  कायाषियन  हेतु व्यापक  डाटाबेस में शाकमि ककया  गया है। 
मंत्राियों/कवभागों  द्वारा राष्ट् र ीय मास्टर  प्लान पोटषि पर  आंकडे  अपिोड करने  (पररयोजना  के

2296. श्री अब्दुल वहाब: 
 
क्या  वाणिज्य और  उद्योग मंत्री यह बताने की  क ृ पा  कर ें गे  कक : 
 
(क ) किगत पााँच िर्षों में खोले गए स्टार्टअप  उद्यमों की  राज्य -िार  और  क्षेत्र-िार  संख्या ककतनी  है; 
(ख) इन स्टार्टअप्स  में ककए  गए घर े लू और  अंतराटष्ट्र ीय दोनों कनिेशों का  ब्यौरा  क्या  है; और  
(ग) किगत पााँच िर्षों में बंद हुए स्टार्टअप  उद्यमों की  राज्य -िार  और  क्षेत्र-िार  संख्या ककतनी  है? 
उत्तर  
वाणिज्‍य और  उद्योग मंत्रालय में राज्य मंत्री 
(श्री सोम प्रकाश) 
 
(क):  स्टार्टअप  इंकिया पहल के  तहत, उद्योग संिर्टन  और  आंतररक  व्यापार किभाग 
(िीपीआईआईर्ी ) द्वारा क ं पकनयों  को  कदनांक  19 फरिरी , 2019 की  जीएसआर  अकर्सूचना  
127 (ङ) तहत कनर्ाटररत  पात्रता शतों के  अनुसार  स्टार्टअप  के  रूप  में मान्यता प्रदान की  जाती 
है। 30 जून 2022 तक  िीपीआईआईर्ी  द्वारा 72,993 क ं पकनयों  को  स्टार्टअप  के  रूप  में 
मान्यता प्रदान की  गई है। 
  
किगत पांच िर्षों (िर्षट 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020 और  2021) में िीपीआईआईर्ी  द्वारा 
60,181 क ं पकनयों  को  स्टार्टअप  के  रूप  में मान्यता प्रदान की  गई। राज्य -िार  सूची अनुबंर्-I 
में दी गई है। 
  
मान्यता प्राप्त स्टार्टअप  56 क्षेत्रों में फ ै ले हुए हैं और  किगत पांच िर्षों (िर्षट 2017, 2018, 2019, 
2020 और  2021) में िीपीआईआईर्ी  द्वारा स्टार्टअप  के  रूप  में मान्यता प्राप्त क ं पकनयों  की  
संख्या अनुबंर्- II में दी गई है। 
  
(ख) और  (ग): ऐसी सूचना का  कोई  क ें द्रीक ृ त  संकलन  नही ं है।

भारत  सरकार  
वाणिज्य और  उद्योग मंत्रालय 
उद्योग संवर्धन और  आंतररक  व्यापार णवभाग  
राज्य सभा 
अतारांणकत  प्रश्‍न संख्या: 2298 
शुक्रवार, 05 अगस्त, 2022 को उत्तर णिए जाने  के णलए 
 
 
स्टार्धअप के णलए अनुपालन संबंर्ी बोझ 
 
2298. डा॰ फौणजया  खान : 
 
क्या वाणिज्य और  उद्योग मंत्री  यह बताने  की  क ृ पा  कर ें गे  कक: 
 
(क ) सरकार  द्वारा किशेष रूप  से स्टार्टअप्स  के  किए अनुपािन  संबंधी बोझ को  कम  करने  हेतु  उठाए गए  
कदमों  का  ब्यौरा  क्या है; 
(ख ) यकद हााँ, तो  तत्संबंधी  ब्यौरा  क्या है, और  यकद नही ं, तो  इसक े क्या कारण  हैं; 
(ग ) क्या सरकार  स्टार्टअप्स  की  किकनयामक और  अनुपािन  किषय में  सहायता  करने  हेतु  उन्हें मुफ्त  परामशट  
सेिाए ं प्रदान  कर  रही  है या प्रदान  करने  का  किचार  कर  रही  है; और  
(घ) यकद हााँ, तो  तत्संबंधी  ब्यौरा  क्या है, और  यकद नही ं, तो  इसक े क्या कारण  हैं? 
 
उत्तर  
वाणिज्‍य और  उद्योग मंत्रालय में राज्य मंत्री 
(श्री सोम प्रकाश) 
 
(क) और  (ख ): सरकार  ने देश में  निप्र योग  और  स्टार्टअप  को  बढािा देने के  किए एक  मजबूत  इको कसस्टम  
बनाने के  उद्देश्य से 16 जनिरी  2016 को  स्टार्टअप  इंकिया पहि  का  शुभारम्भ  ककया है। 
स्टार्टअप  इंकिया पहि  के  तहत , सरकार  ने 2016 से ईज  ऑफ ि ू इंग कबजनेस को  बढािा 
देने, पूंजी  जुर्ाने  में  आसानी और  स्टार्टअप  इको कसस्टम  के  अनुपािन  बोझ को  कम  करने  के  
किए 52 किकनयामक  सुधार  शुरू  ककए हैं। शुरू  ककए गए  सुधारों  की  सूची  अनुबंर्-I में  दी गई  
है। 
(ग) और  (घ): स्टार्टअप  इंकिया पहि  के  उद्देश्यों को  पूरा  करने  के  किए, सरकार  ने 16 जनिरी  2016 को  
स्टार्टअप  इंकिया के  किए एक  कायट  योजना  की  शुरूआत  की  है कजसमें  देश में  एक  जीिंत  
स्टार्टअप  इको कसस्टम  बनाने के  किए सरकारी  सहायता , योजनाओं  और  प्रोत्साहनों  की  
आधारकशिा  रखी।  इस कायट  योजना  में  "सरिीकरण  और  हैंिहोल्डंग ", "कित्त पोषण  सहायता  
और  प्रोत्साहन " और  "उद्योग-कशक्षा जगत  साझेदारी  और  इन्क्क्यूबेशन" जैसे  क्षेत्रों  में  फ ै िे 19 
कायट  मद ें शाकमि हैं। इस संबंध में , सरकार  ने 19 जून  2017 को  स्टार्टअप  इंकिया ऑनिाइन 
हब का  शुभारम्भ  ककया, जो  भारत  में  उद्यमशीिता  इको कसस्टम  के  सभी कहतधारकों  के  किए 
एक -द ू सर े का  पता  करने , सम्पक ट  करने  और  कमि जुि  कर  काम  करने  के  किए, ज्ञान का  
प्रसार  करने  और  पहंच  प्रदान  करने  िािे एकि  गेर्िे  के  रूप  में  स्टार्टअप  के  किए किकनयामक 
अनुपािन , योजनाओं  और  कायटक्रमों  सकहत किकभन्न सरकारी  कायटक्रमों  के  किए अपनी  तरह  
का  एक  ऑनिाइन प्लेर्फॉमट  है। यह ऑनिाइन हब स्टार्टअ प्स, कनिेशकों , फ ं ि्स, 
643

मागटदशट कों , शैक्षकणक संस्थानों, इनक्यूबेर् सट, एक्सेिेर े र् सट, कॉरपोर े र् , सरकारी  कनकायों और  
अन्य कहतधारकों  को  िाभाल्ित  करता  है।
